card.title: Fishing for Praise
card.instruction: You desperately want praise but refuse to ask for it. Create opportunities for others to notice your greatness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've left my marathon medal beside the kettle. Accidentally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A difficult obstacle. Much like mile twenty-three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, you noticed? I haven't shown you the split times.
